executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
gate=json.loads((out/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
rows=json.loads((out/'原公告字段及原因记录.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for rel,h in freeze['parent_input_hashes'].items():assert sha(root/rel)==h
assert len(rows)==16 and [x['quarter'] for x in rows]==json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['fixed_current_quarters']
assert len({x['quarter'] for x in rows})==16
complete=[x for x in rows if x['current_table_three_rows_available']]
for x in complete:
    calc=x['cash_contribution_total']+x['financing_need_revision_reported']+x['other_sources_borrowing_contribution']+x['decomposition_display_residual']
    assert calc==x['reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd'],x['quarter']
assert len(complete)==15
assert [x['quarter'] for x in rows if x['reported_borrowing_revision_billion_usd']*x['cash_adjusted_borrowing_revision_not_financing_need']<0]==result['reported_borrowing_vs_cash_adjusted_revision_opposite_sign_quarters']
assert gate['full_source_gate_passed'] is False and result['net_sharpe']=='NOT_COMPUTED'
assert result['new_equity_labels']==result['new_fits']==result['new_account_backtests']==result['new_repository_source_code_edits']==0
q2=next(x for x in rows if x['quarter']=='2023Q2')
assert q2['financing_need_revision_reported'] is None and q2['all_other_sources_revision_reported'] is None
programs=sorted(out.glob('*执行记录.json'))
assert len(programs)==8,(len(programs),[p.name for p in programs])
program_hashes={p.name:hashlib.sha256(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['executed_source'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() for p in programs}
texts=[]
report=out/'16季度借款修订原因_来源结论.md';texts.append((report,report.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
state=root/'docs/PROJECT_STATE.md';st=state.read_text(encoding='utf-8');a=st.index('### 5.11');b=st.index('## 6.',a);texts.append((state,st[a:b]))
dec=root/'docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md';dt=dec.read_text(encoding='utf-8');a=dt.index('### R69｜');b=dt.index('## 八、',a);texts.append((dec,dt[a:b]))
linked=set()
for path,text in texts:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)\n]+)\)',text):
        if target.startswith(('https:','http:','#')):continue
        p=(path.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert p.exists(),str(p);linked.add(str(p))
for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']:
    cfg=json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert cfg['latest_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_source'].endswith('510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/result.json')
mandate=json.loads((root/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert mandate['target_net_sharpe']==1.2 and mandate['orders_authorized'] is False and mandate['goal_achieved'] is False
g=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--numstat'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',check=True)
statlines=[line.split('\t') for line in g.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
changes=[line for line in statlines if len(line)==3 and line[0].isdigit() and line[1].isdigit()]
gitinfo={'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True).strip(),
    'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
    'tracked_changed_files':len(statlines),'insertions':sum(int(x[0]) for x in changes),'deletions':sum(int(x[1]) for x in changes),
    'staged_files':subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()}
check={'checked_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'status':'PASS_SAVED_SOURCE_CAUSE_CHECK_ONLY',
    'original_protocol_unchanged':True,'parent_hashes_checked':len(freeze['parent_input_hashes']),
    'saved_fixed_quarters_checked':16,'saved_component_bridges_checked':15,'missing_financing_fields_remain_null':True,
    'descriptive_sign_case_count_recomputed':4,'complete_execution_records':len(programs),'program_source_sha256':program_hashes,
    'local_material_links_checked':len(linked),'scope_and_mandate_progress_links_checked':2,'git':gitinfo,
    'full_source_gate_passed':False,'economic_strategy_validation_performed':False,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
    'source_code_edits_by_this_experiment':0,'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False}
(out/'保存来源构成必要核对.json').write_text(json.dumps(check,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('必要保存核对通过：16季度、15构成桥、4方向反转；缺项仍为空；3父记录/协议未变；完整程序8条；本地证据链接',len(linked),'项。')
print('Git',gitinfo)
for name,needle in [('docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','### 5.11'),('docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md','### R69｜')]:
    ls=(root/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines();print(name,'行号',next(i for i,l in enumerate(ls,1) if l.startswith(needle)))
print('来源门未通过，金融验证没有运行；目标/风险预算/权限未改变。')
